name: Speakers, buzzers and sirens
summary: Speakers, buzzers, horns and sirens that make sound, plus their magnets.
identify: Paper or plastic cones with a magnet in TVs, stereos, vehicles and PA cabinets; piezo discs in smoke alarms, toys and appliances; loud sirens on alarm panels and fire systems; horn speakers on poles and in schools.
test: Touch a speaker to a 1.5V cell: it should click. The coil usually reads 4–8 Ω.

decay.note: Lasts; foam surrounds on old speakers crumble.
